_source: Shaped from the Cloudflare API v4 reference: list D1 databases (GET /accounts/{account_id}/d1/database?name=) and query (POST .../d1/database/{id}/query, {sql} -> result[0].results), 2026-11-07; ids are fake. The rows are the watchdog's key/value table: the agent's inventory (v1.3 product + selftest) and the Worker's version stamp. Drift: the server and the Worker are on other commits than the pin, and the self-test fails.
